faqs.question: Are Bing Ads really worth running for a dentist?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bing powers roughly 30% of US desktop searches. The audience skews older and wealthier—prime candidates for high-margin procedures like implants and dentures.

faqs.question: What is a good conversion rate for a dental landing page?
faqs.answer: Industry average is 3-5%. However, our dedicated, hyper-optimized dental landing pages frequently achieve conversion rates of 10-15%+.

faqs.question: Do we need a special offer to run PPC?
faqs.answer: While not strictly mandatory, having a compelling New Patient Special drastically lowers your Cost-Per-Acquisition and improves overall campaign velocity.

faqs.question: How do you handle no-shows from PPC ads?
faqs.answer: We mitigate no-shows by targeting higher-intent keywords and implementing automated SMS reminders the moment a lead enters your CRM.

faqs.question: Do I get to keep the landing pages?
faqs.answer: Yes, we believe in complete transparency and asset ownership. You retain full rights to the funnels we build for your campaigns.
